bali.meta_title: Bali Tour Packages | Smart Muslim by Roystar Travel & Tours
bali.meta_description: Discover Bali with four private tour packages, from a romantic 4D3N escape to a 5D4N Nusa Penida adventure.
bali.hero_body: Choose a romantic island escape, visit Bali’s iconic temples and beaches, or add an unforgettable day discovering Nusa Penida.
bali.intro_body: From the mountain views of Kintamani to the beaches of Melasti and Jimbaran, discover Bali with a private itinerary designed around the moments you want to experience. Choose from four tour packages, including a 5D4N journey to Nusa Penida.
bali.highlights_eyebrow: A BALI JOURNEY FOR EVERY TRAVELLER
bali.highlights_headline: Find the trip that feels like yours.
bali.highlights_body: Four private tour choices bring Bali’s temples, landscapes and island life together.

highlights.title: Honeymoon moments
highlights.body: Enjoy Bali’s scenery, a sunset dinner by Jimbaran Beach and a romantic private escape.

highlights.title: Temples & traditions
highlights.body: Visit Uluwatu, Tanah Lot, Lempuyang and Tirta Gangga on selected itineraries.

highlights.title: Island adventures
highlights.body: Take in Kintamani’s mountain and lake views or discover Nusa Penida’s dramatic coast.

bali.contact_headline: Let’s find the right Bali package for you.
bali.contact_body: Ask our travel team about the Honeymoon, Heaven Gate, Fantastik or Nusa Penida itinerary, and get current pricing and availability.

package_data.itineraries_body: All tours include private transport, hotel accommodation with breakfast, guided visits, entrance fees and meals as listed.

itineraries.title: Honeymoon
itineraries.summary: A romantic escape with mountain scenery, Bali temples and dinner by the sea.

days.title: Arrive in Bali
days.body: Arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport, meet your local representative and transfer to the hotel. Enjoy free time for personal activities.

days.title: Aloha Swing & Kintamani
days.body: Visit Aloha Swing, including its swings and photo nests. Have lunch in Kintamani with views of Mount and Lake Batur, visit a Bali coffee plantation and enjoy dinner at a local restaurant before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Tanah Lot & Melasti Beach
days.body: Visit Tanah Lot Temple and Melasti Beach. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant and a romantic dinner at Jimbaran Beach before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Depart from Bali
days.body: Have breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport.

itineraries.title: Heaven Gate
itineraries.summary: Discover Bali’s celebrated temples, cultural stops and the coast.

days.title: Arrival, Uluwatu & Jimbaran
days.body: Arrive in Bali and visit Uluwatu Temple. Enjoy a barbecue dinner at Jimbaran, then check in at the hotel.

days.title: Kintamani & Alas Harum
days.body: Visit a batik factory, Celuk’s silver artisans and a coffee plantation featuring Kopi Luwak. Have lunch in Kintamani, visit Alas Harum and shop for souvenirs. Dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Heaven Gate & Virgin Beach
days.body: Set out early to visit Lempuyang Temple, Tirta Gangga and Virgin Beach. Enjoy lunch and dinner at local restaurants.

days.title: Depart from Bali
days.body: Have breakfast and transfer to the airport.

itineraries.title: Fantastik
itineraries.summary: Pair Kintamani and Alas Harum with the beaches and temples of southern Bali.

days.title: Arrive in Bali
days.body: Arrive at Ngurah Rai Airport, meet your local representative and transfer directly to the hotel. Free time for personal activities.

days.title: Kintamani & Alas Harum
days.body: Visit Batubulan Batik Factory, Celuk’s silver artisans and a traditional coffee plantation featuring Kopi Luwak. Have lunch in Kintamani with Mount and Lake Batur views. Visit Alas Harum Tegalalang (swing not included), shop for souvenirs and enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Nusa Dua, Melasti & Uluwatu
days.body: Optional water sports are available at Tanjung Benoa (not included). Visit Puja Mandala, relax or swim at Melasti Beach and see Uluwatu Temple on the cliff. Have lunch at a local restaurant and a seafood barbecue dinner at Jimbaran.

days.title: Depart from Bali
days.body: Have breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport.

itineraries.title: Nusa Penida
itineraries.summary: Explore southern Bali before spending a day among Nusa Penida’s coastal landmarks.

days.title: Arrive in Bali
days.body: Arrive in Bali, meet your local representative and check in at the hotel. Enjoy free time for personal activities.

days.title: Kintamani & Alas Harum
days.body: Visit a batik factory, Celuk’s silver artisans and a traditional coffee plantation featuring Kopi Luwak. Have lunch in Kintamani with mountain and lake views. Visit Alas Harum (swing not included), shop for souvenirs and enjoy dinner at a local restaurant.

days.title: Nusa Dua, Melasti & Uluwatu
days.body: Optional water sports are available at Tanjung Benoa (not included). Visit Puja Mandala, Melasti Beach and Uluwatu Temple. Have lunch at a local restaurant and barbecue dinner at Jimbaran.

days.title: Nusa Penida island tour
days.body: Depart early for Nusa Penida and visit Broken Beach, Angel’s Billabong and Kelingking Beach. Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant, then return to the hotel for dinner.

days.title: Depart from Bali
days.body: Have breakfast and transfer to the airport.

aceh.meta_title: 4D3N Aceh Tour Package | Smart Muslim by Roystar Travel & Tours
aceh.meta_description: Explore Aceh or combine it with Sabang Island on a private 4D3N tour from Kuala Lumpur, with local meals, guided visits and hotel accommodation.
aceh.hero_body: Explore Aceh’s history, culture and coastal beauty, or travel by ferry to Sabang and discover the beaches of Weh Island on a private 4D3N journey.
aceh.hero_note: KUALA LUMPUR · ACEH · OPTIONAL SABANG ISLAND
aceh.intro_body: Begin in Banda Aceh with meaningful historical sites, mosques and local culture. Choose the Aceh city and beach tour, or add an overnight stay on Sabang Island with its beaches and Indonesia’s Kilometer 0 Monument. Both itineraries include local meals and a private guided tour.
aceh.highlights_body: Both private itineraries include accommodation, guided visits, transportation and meals.

highlights.title: Aceh city & coast
highlights.body: Visit tsunami landmarks, museums, Gunongan Historical Park, Pasar Atjeh and the beaches of Lhoknga and Lampuuk.

highlights.title: Aceh + Sabang
highlights.body: Take a ferry to Sabang and explore Sumur Tiga, Gapang and Iboih beaches, plus the Kilometer 0 Monument.

highlights.title: Local meals & stays
highlights.body: Enjoy full meals on tour days, hotel breakfasts, and overnight stays in Aceh or Sabang according to your route.

aceh.contact_headline: Tell us which 4D3N journey sounds right for you.
aceh.contact_body: Ask our team about the Aceh City & Beach itinerary or the Aceh + Sabang island journey. Contact us for current pricing and flight options.

package_data.itineraries_body: Arrival and departure are through Sultan Iskandar Muda International Airport (BTJ). Daily activities may be arranged with your local guide.

itineraries.title: Aceh City & Beach
itineraries.summary: History, local culture and the coast around Banda Aceh.

days.title: Kuala Lumpur → Aceh
days.body: Arrive at Sultan Iskandar Muda International Airport (BTJ) and meet your local guide. Visit the Tsunami Mass Grave at Siro Village, Baiturrahim Mosque and PLTD Apung (Floating Power Ship), then transfer to your hotel to check in.

days.title: Aceh City Tour
days.body: Visit Gunongan Historical Park and Kapal di Atas Rumah (Boat on the House), followed by the Aceh Tsunami Museum and Aceh Museum. Enjoy shopping time at Pasar Atjeh before returning to the hotel.

days.title: Aceh Culture & Beaches
days.body: Explore Cut Nyak Dien House, the former residence of Aceh’s national heroine. Continue to Lhoknga Beach and Lampuuk Beach, where lunch features grilled fish (ikan bakar). Enjoy leisure time or shopping at Pasar Atjeh.

days.title: Aceh → Kuala Lumpur
days.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your departure flight to Kuala Lumpur. Your tour concludes here.

itineraries.title: Aceh + Sabang
itineraries.summary: Add a ferry crossing and an island stay on Sabang (Weh Island).

days.title: Kuala Lumpur → Aceh
days.body: Arrive at Sultan Iskandar Muda International Airport (BTJ) and meet your guide. Visit the Tsunami Mass Grave at Siro Village, Baiturrahim Mosque and the Aceh Tsunami Museum, then check in to your hotel.

days.title: Aceh → Sabang Island
days.body: Transfer to Ulee Lheue Port and take the approximately one-hour ferry to Balohan Port, Sabang. Explore Sumur Tiga, Gapang and Iboih beaches and the Kilometer 0 Monument of Indonesia. Check in to your Sabang hotel. Optional activities such as snorkeling, diving, and glass boat rides are available at own expense.

days.title: Sabang → Aceh
days.body: Return to Aceh by ferry. Visit PLTD Apung, a local pesantren (Islamic boarding school) and an orphanage. Enjoy shopping at Pasar Atjeh before returning to your hotel.

days.title: Aceh → Kuala Lumpur
days.body: After breakfast, check out and transfer to the airport for your return flight. The tour ends with wonderful memories of Aceh and Sabang.

package_data.gallery_body: From Banda Aceh’s landmarks to Sabang’s island shores.
